name: Tulsa (United States)
description: A cream field bearing a gold-bordered navy shield charged with a red-and-gold star rising over a curved base.
history: Adopted in 2018 after a citizen-led redesign campaign; the shield echoes Tulsa's art-deco architecture and the star the Creek council fire at Council Oak.

features.symbolism: the shield of Tulsa's art-deco heritage; the star marks the city as the meeting place of the Creek council fire
